Copilot Demo - Adding Fields from Related Tables

features.name: Analysis Assist Copilot
features.description: Copilot experience for natural language data analysis that can traverse the data model to add fields from related tables and join data sources together.

features.name: Add Columns from Related Tables
features.description: Feature allowing copilot to add fields from tables related to the current analysis, enabling joins across the data model to bring in additional columns like location name.

features.name: Server-Side Data Loading
features.description: When adding data from other tables or analyzing large data sets or query objects, data analysis switches from client-side to server-side loading for on-demand data retrieval.
caveats: Flow fields cannot be calculated on the server side

features.name: Pivot on Date Hierarchy in Server-Side Mode
features.description: New capability to pivot on date hierarchy fields (year, quarter, month) when in server-side mode, which was previously unsupported in this mode.

features.name: Right-Click Menu for Data Analysis
features.description: Productivity improvements with right-click context menu options including add to labels, group/ungroup from row groups, and scroll into view action to navigate fields.

features.name: Data Analysis Feature
features.description: Ad hoc analysis tool available on list pages and queries allowing users to pivot and group data without building formal reports, used by over 70% of Business Central customers.

quotes.text: more than 70% of all Business Central customers use data analysis, also known as analysis mode
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the broad adoption and customer reliance on this feature, justifying investment in improvements.

quotes.text: we even added a great co-pilot experience a couple of releases back so that you can also use natural language
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms copilot support for natural language queries was added in a previous release, with new enhancements now.

quotes.text: we have now ability for analysis assist to also add fields from tables that are related to what you're using here
quotes.why_it_matters: Key new capability enabling cross-table joins through copilot intelligence without manual configuration.

quotes.text: there are few things we you can't do such as flow fields things that are calculated
quotes.why_it_matters: Documents important constraints of server-side mode relevant for users working with complex calculated fields.

quotes.text: One of the things you could not do in serverside mode until this release is pivoting on date hierarchy
quotes.why_it_matters: Removes a specific limitation that previously prevented date hierarchy pivoting in server-side mode.
